_comment: Thematic-cluster manifest for tools/generate.py. Claude plugin source lives under plugins/elian-store; Codex shared skills point there by symlink, while prompt-only adapters remain independent. Skill counts are discovered dynamically.

elian-artifacts.description: Artifact generation and team orchestration: route to the right workflow, render schema-validated documents, build decision dashboards, spawn teammates, and brainstorm before committing.

elian-tdd.description: Approval-gated TDD development flow: implement features, fix bugs, and make behavior-changing improvements with shared execution strategy.

elian-review.description: Engineering review and verification: findings-first code review, persona-lens review, verify-skill discovery, verify-skill drift repair, a claim-time evidence gate, requirement-to-test coverage tracking, and the consumer side of receiving review feedback.

elian-design.description: Design and authoring: requirements intake, gated design-document generation, design-change propagation, UI/UX design artifacts, wireframe-to-code functional specs, schema lineage previews, local task boards, and self-contained house-styled documents.

elian-harness.description: Maintainer tooling: reconcile Claude/Codex global harness drift, draft review-friendly PR/MR descriptions, and finish a development branch (merge / PR / keep / discard) with worktree-safe cleanup.

codex._comment: Codex distribution per skill. claude_only = blocked by a real runtime limitation; prompt_only = hand-authored Codex prompt; deferred = portable but intentionally not shipped yet; everything else ships as a codex/skills/<name> symlink.
